parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of rows per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: NetworkAccessEndpointStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the network access endpoint. Valid values:
 
- pending: pending initialization.
- creating: being created.
- running: running.
- deleting: being deleted.

This filter parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared.

parameters.name: NetworkAccessEndpointType
parameters.description:
The type of the network access endpoint. Valid values:

- shared: shared network access endpoint.
- private: dedicated network access endpoint.

Default value: private.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first query.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID of the dedicated network access endpoint. This parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared.

parameters.name: VpcRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the VPC for the dedicated network access endpoint. The region must be one of the regions returned by the ListNetworkAccessEndpointAvailableRegions operation. This parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared.
